Tag short description: Product Packaging - Leakage issues, information on packaging, token inside, token scanning, ease of opening and closing pack, longevity of product provided by packaging. Application includes ease of applying product on substrate - whether it be laminate, or any other surface. Single vs. multi-direction application, requirement of masking tape, application on plywood vs. Laminate. Application related complaints - bubble formation, uneven surface, rubbery glue, odd smell, difficulty in adhesion.
Improvements can include areas such as strength of product, new avenues of application, longevity of product, shelf life, pot life
Improvements can include ease of storage, transportation, uniqueness, easy identification, PIL branding, token identification, scanning options, clarity in manufacturing and expiry dates.
Credit days competition offers to dealers - can be 3,4,6 months. High credit days is sometimes a reason for dealer to purchase competition. PIL provides 30 days across most of its products.

Delay in stock from distributor or company can lead to dealer disgruntlement. Stock unavailability is also a concern for dealers. When dealer faces stock issue, dealer will resort to wholesale market for urgent requirements.

Common dealer disgrutlement issues - stock issues, pending scheme settlements, employees not visiting, damaged stock received, disgruntement with distributor, lack of user meets for dealer's key users, no gifts from company.
